runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of the memorandum. The same 180-day threshold applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract.

The passages also say the memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System. In addition, the passages show that AI used incidentally by a contractor during performance of a contract is among the items excluded from scope, though the excerpt begins mid-list and I can't see the full set of exclusions.

Passage lists incidental contractor AI, but doesn't say here that the memo doesn't apply; appears to be a list item, likely exclusion.
